breakdown.interpretation: First usable input is an actual acknowledged current-Show focus input after initial framebuffer commit. Its elapsed Boot interval includes harness arrival/capture and input dispatch; it is not time-to-input-readiness. Stage intervals may overlap and include nested observation publication; do not sum them or infer a counter frequency. Host typing and page-navigation intervals are retained separately.

guest.interpretation: Instrumented Root intervals include nested observer publication and may end on refusal. Outcomes and identities belong to the correlated guest records. First framebuffer commit is not a physical display observation. No ticks-to-time conversion or physical latency claim.
